A Star Wars CCG bot game on TCGMix, captured on 7 November 2026. The board shows Tatooine and Death Star locations, deployed Stormtroopers, the player's hand, Force piles and turn controls. Screenshot captured from the browser without alteration. Original card artwork belongs to its respective rights holders.<ref>[https://tcgmix.com/starwars/ Star Wars Customizable Card Game], TCGMix. Preserved copy of the public game entry page: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107172027/https://tcgmix.com/starwars/ Internet Archive].</ref>
